headline: Approved bid awards for lead abatement, water main work, and several Public Works vehicles
summary: The committee approved minutes from July 13, 2026, and voted 4-0 on a series of bid awards and contracts. These included lead abatement at 128 Oxford St., a wash facility design task order, a water main change order, several Public Works vehicle purchases, and a water main replacement and road rehab project.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting dated July 13, 2026, 4-0
Awarded bid 2026-033 for Lead Abatement of 128 Oxford St. to Region 1 Construction, Auburn, ME, at $170,000, including $12,000 owner match, 4-0
Authorized the Task Order for Public Works Wash Facility Design Services with Harriman Associates, not to exceed $182,500, 4-0
Ratified Change Order #1 to the 2025-029 Granite, Lowell, Bates Water Main Replacement project to add two deteriorated sewer services, revised estimated bid award $548,745.00, 4-0
Awarded 2026-029 for a 4x4 cab and chassis with welding service body and crane to O'Connor Auto Park, Augusta, ME, at $212,001 net of trade, 4-0
Awarded bid 2026-030 for a 1-ton traffic/sign truck to O'Connor Auto Park, Augusta, ME, at $123,331 net of trade, 4-0
Awarded bid 2026-031 for a 1/2-ton 4x4 pickup truck to O'Connor Auto Park, Augusta, ME, at $47,745, 4-0
Awarded bid 2026-032 for two 3/4-ton 4x4 pickup trucks to O'Connor Auto Park, Augusta, ME, at $97,938 net of trade, 4-0
Awarded 2026-024 for the Wilson, Hamel, Demi, Bellegarde Water Main Replacement & Road Rehab to Perryman Construction, Lewiston, ME, for an estimated $1,052,268, 4-0

plain_text:
FINANCE COMMITTEE 
Lewiston, ME 
Minutes of  
July 27, 2026 
 
PRESENT: Chairman Chittim, Councilor Nagine, Ms. McCabe, and Ms. Hoskins  
 
ABSENT: Mr. Bouh 
 
OTHERS PRESENT: Deputy Director of Budget and Purchasing, Allen Ward , Assistant City 
Engineer, Peralie Burbank, Fleet Operations Manager, Phil Brienza, and Assistant Community 
Development Manager, Jaqueline Sawyer 
  
The meeting was called to order at 5:30 p.m.  
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(105-2026) To approve the minutes of the previous meeting dated July 13, 2026, and to accept and 
place them on file by the Clerk. 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(106-2026) To award bid 2026 -033 for the Lead Abatement of 128 Oxford St . to Region 1 
Construction, Auburn, ME, at their bid price of $170,000, including the $12,000 owner match. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(107-2026) To authorize the Task Order for the Public Works Wash Facility Design Services with 
Harriman Associates for an amount not to exceed $182,500. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(108-2026) To ratify 2025-029 Granite, Lowell, Bates Water Main Replacement Change Order #1 
to add the replacement of two (2) deteriorated sewer services into the project scope with Hird 
Contracting at their estimated price of $22,762.50 and a revised estimated bid award of 
$548,745.00. 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was,
FINANCE COMMITTEE                                                                                        July 27, 2026 
VOTED:  
(109-2026) To award 2026-029 for one (1) 4x4 cab and chassis with a welding service body and 
crane for Public Works to O’Connor Auto Park, Augusta, ME, at their bid price of $212,001, net 
of trade. 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(110-2026) To award bid 2026 -030 for one (1) 1 -ton traffic/sign truck for Public Works to 
O’Connor Auto Park, Augusta, ME, at their bid price of $123,331, net of trade. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(111-2026) To award bid 2026 -031 for one (1) ½ -ton 4x4 pickup truck for Public Works to 
O’Connor Auto Park, Augusta, ME at their bid price of $47,745. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(112-2026) To award bid 2026 -032 for two (2) ¾ -ton 4x4 pickup trucks for Public Works to 
O’Connor Auto Park, Augusta, ME, at their bid price of $97,938, net of trade. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(113-2026) To award 2026-024 for the Wilson, Hamel, Demi, Bellegarde Water Main 
Replacement & Road Rehab to Perryman Construction, Lewiston, ME, for an estimated bid 
amount of $1,052,268 based on the itemized bid costs using estimated quantities prepared by the 
Project Engineer. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On motion of Ms. McCabe, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, 
 
VOTED: 
To adjourn at 6:05 p.m.     
 
              ___________________________________ 
                                      Allen Ward 
                                                                    Clerk  
        Finance Committee
